purpose: Freeze exact official IGP source feature IDs for bounded local named channel-line review. Accepted outputs are channel context only, never catchment polygons, outlets, event footprints, routing or activation evidence. A same-name Río Seco feature is explicitly rejected after static spatial review and must not be published as the CENDEHUA Río Seco geometry.

selection_provenance.initial_selection_basis: Official source name plus administrative context only.

igp_roj_reference.coordinate_precision_note: Published rounded observatory coordinate; used only to reject grossly incompatible same-name source geometry, not to infer an outlet.

igp_cendehua_context.bounded_claim: IGP places monitored Huaycoloro and Río Seco near the Radio Observatorio de Jicamarca at the Lurigancho-Chosica/San Antonio boundary, approximately 5 km upstream of Cajamarquilla.

rejected_after_geometry_review.review_basis: The official source line occupies approximately 11.738-11.748 S / 76.804-76.809 W, more than 20 km from the rounded official ROJ reference and incompatible with IGP's monitored Río Seco context near the observatory/Cajamarquilla boundary. Administrative district plus repeated name was insufficient identity evidence.

withheld_from_geometry_publication.reason: No IGP Quebrada_Lima feature has yet been reproducibly tied to the CENDEHUA Río Seco monitored reach; the only San Antonio same-name candidate was spatially rejected.
Multiple official source segments occur across several districts and the relation to Huaycoloro/Río Seco remains unresolved; no subset is admissible yet.
Existing IRFEN pilot chosica_huaycoloro must be reused by reference; duplicate geometry is forbidden.

forbidden: union source segments into a catchment polygon
infer outlet or confluence from a line endpoint
infer travel time or attenuation from line length
use source classification as an IRFEN threshold
promote tributary activation to Rimac activation or overflow
publish the rejected Río Seco same-name feature
publish the Jicamarca parent as a synthetic local activation geometry
